$comment: Handler-visible API allowlist in the Workers dialect (LLP 0048 §Handler-visible API surface). The surface is subtractive on the V8 leg (workerd strips everything off-list) and additive on the Ibex leg (missing entries are installed by allowlist-install.js, or the API is banned for both). Member-granular: admitting an object member never admits its siblings.

computeOnlyAllowlist.name: TextEncoder
computeOnlyAllowlist.semantics: WHATWG utf-8 encode; encode()/encodeInto() over BMP and surrogate pairs

computeOnlyAllowlist.name: TextDecoder
computeOnlyAllowlist.semantics: WHATWG utf-8 decode, including streaming state, incomplete-sequence flush, fatal recovery, and per-stream BOM handling; accepts every UTF-8 encoding label after trimming only WHATWG ASCII whitespace and applies Web IDL label conversion

computeOnlyAllowlist.name: atob
computeOnlyAllowlist.semantics: WHATWG forgiving-base64 decode to binary string; ignores ASCII whitespace and accepts omitted canonical padding, but rejects misplaced, short, or extra padding and other non-base64 input

computeOnlyAllowlist.name: btoa
computeOnlyAllowlist.semantics: WHATWG base64 encode from binary string; throws on code points above 0xFF

computeOnlyAllowlist.name: console
computeOnlyAllowlist.semantics: diagnostics-routed: log/info/warn/error/debug forward to the runtime.log host op during an invocation and are dropped outside one; never engine-native stdout

computeOnlyAllowlist.name: queueMicrotask
computeOnlyAllowlist.semantics: microtask scheduling; ordering-only, carries no clock or entropy. Declared engine fact (ENG-23593): the FINE-GRAINED interleave of queueMicrotask jobs with promise reactions differs between V8 and the Ibex vendored promise polyfill, so handlers must not depend on cross-engine job ordering beyond same-source FIFO

bannedEverywhere.$comment: Denied at runtime on both engines regardless of engine defaults; codegen also bans the dynamic-code paths so the runtime probe is not bypassable.

stripProbes.$comment: Names the negative probe asserts are unreachable (undefined or SNAPBACK_HANDLER_AMBIENT_CAPABILITY_DENIED) after harness init on both engines.
